t: Introduction and overview — Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980)
name: Introduction and overview — Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980) — car record
title: Introduction and overview — Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980)
description: Introduction and overview of the Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Plymouth Road Runner stripped muscle cars to basics: big engine, minimal trim, and a cartoon horn that went 'beep-beep.' The 1968 model with the 383 V8 cost under $3,000 and won Motor Trend Car of the Year. 45,000 sold in 1968 alone, proving performance didn't need luxury pricing. title: Engineering deep-dive — Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980)
description: Engineering deep-dive of the Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980): Materials, structures, and the engineering decisions behind the car. The Plymouth Road Runner stripped muscle cars to basics: big engine, minimal trim, and a cartoon horn that went 'beep-beep.' The 1968 model with the 383 V8 cost under $3,000 and won Motor Trend Car of the Year. 45,000 sold in 1968 alone, proving performance didn't need luxury pricing. Baseline facts: American muscle car 1968-1980; 45,000 sold in 1968; cartoon-licensed budget muscle..

demo.program:
# Plymouth Road Runner (1968-1980) — working demonstration (runs real numbers from the archive record)
power_hp = 335
weight_lb = 3600
zero_sixty_s = 6.8
weight_kg = weight_lb * 0.453592
hp_per_tonne = power_hp / (weight_kg / 1000)
avg_accel = 26.8224 / zero_sixty_s  # 0-60 mph in m/s^2
print(f"Power-to-weight: {hp_per_tonne:.1f} hp per tonne")
print(f"Average 0-60 mph acceleration: {avg_accel:.2f} m/s^2")
